sentences.text: Sikkim -LRB- -LSB- ˈsɪkᵻm -RSB- -RRB- is a northeastern state of India .	India	India	northeastern	Northeast India	state	Indian state

It borders China in its north and east , Bhutan in its east , Nepal in its west and the Indian state of West Bengal in its south .	state	Indian state	China	China	Bhutan	Bhutan	Nepal	Nepal	West Bengal	West Bengal
Sikkim is also located close to the Siliguri Corridor near Bangladesh .	Siliguri Corridor	Siliguri Corridor	Bangladesh	Bangladesh

Sikkim is the least populous and second smallest among the Indian states .	least populous	List of states and union territories of India by population	second smallest	List of states and union territories of India by area

A part of the Eastern Himalaya , Sikkim is notable for its biodiversity , including alpine and subtropical climates , as well as being a host to Kanchenjunga , the highest peak in India and third highest on Earth .	India	India	Eastern Himalaya	Eastern Himalaya	biodiversity	biodiversity	alpine	alpine climate	subtropical	subtropical	Kanchenjunga	Kanchenjunga	highest peak in India	List of mountains in India	third highest on Earth	List of highest mountains on Earth
Sikkim 's capital and largest city is Gangtok .	Gangtok	Gangtok	capital	capital (political)
Almost 35 % of the state is covered by the Khangchendzonga National Park .	state	Indian state	Khangchendzonga National Park	Khangchendzonga National Park
The Kingdom of Sikkim was founded on the Silk Road by the Namgyal dynasty in the 17th century .	Kingdom of Sikkim	Kingdom of Sikkim	Silk Road	Silk Road	Namgyal dynasty	Chogyal
It was ruled by a Buddhist priest-king known as the Chogyal .	Buddhist	Buddhist	Chogyal	Chogyal

Once a vassal state of Qing China , it became a princely state of British India in 1890 .	India	India	state	Indian state	China	China	vassal state	vassal state	Qing China	Qing China	princely state	princely state	British India	British India
After the People 's Republic of China invaded Tibet , Sikkim continued its protectorate status with the dominion and republic of India .	India	India	China	China	protectorate	protectorate
It enjoyed the highest literacy rate and per capita income among Himalayan states .	Himalayan states	Himalayan states
In 1975 , the Indian military deposed the Sikkimese monarchy .	Sikkimese	Sikkimese language	Indian military	Indian military
A referendum in 1975 led to Sikkim joining India as its 22nd state .	India	India	state	Indian state	referendum	Sikkimese monarchy referendum, 1975
Modern Sikkim is a multiethnic and multilingual Indian state .	state	Indian state	multiethnic	multiethnic	multilingual	multilingual

Sikkim has 11 official languages : Nepali , Sikkimese , Lepcha , Tamang , Limbu , Newari , Rai , Gurung , Magar , Sunwar and English .	Nepali	Nepali language	English	Indian English	Gurung	Gurung language	Lepcha	Lepcha language	Newari	Newari language	Rai	Kiranti languages	Sikkimese	Sikkimese language	Tamang	Tamang language	official languages	Official languages of India	Limbu	Limbu language	Magar	Magar language	Sunwar	Sunwar language
English is taught in schools and used in government documents .	English	Indian English
The predominant religions are Hinduism and Vajrayana Buddhism .	Hinduism	Hinduism	Vajrayana Buddhism	Vajrayana Buddhism

Sikkim 's economy is largely dependent on agriculture and tourism , and the state had the third-smallest GDP among Indian states , although it is also among the fastest-growing .	state	Indian state	the third-smallest GDP among Indian states	List of Indian states by GDP
Sikkim accounts for the largest share of cardamom production in India , and is the world 's second largest producer of the spice after Guatemala .	India	India	cardamom	cardamom	Guatemala	Guatemala
Sikkim has the highest share of agricultural land dedicated to organic farming in India .	India	India
It is also among India 's most environmentally conscious states , having banned plastic water bottles and styrofoam products .	India	India
